inj.note: Branch and D.J. Wonnum collided with each other in the second quarter, and both players have been diagnosed with concussions. Keith Abney should see more defensive snaps in Branch's absence.

news.h: Lions to get DB Brian Branch, C Cade Mays back vs. Packers
news.d: The Lions will have both Branch and center Cade Mays for Sunday's game against the Green Bay Packers.
